explanation: Caetano came to the presidency of the council in September 1968 with no title of his own — appointed by a president chosen by an assembly, to replace a man who had never resigned — and an election was the obvious way to acquire one. He called it for October 1969 and ran it as the demonstration piece of the opening: opposition lists permitted for the first time in a decade, the censorship relaxed for the campaign, and the result never in any doubt.
